title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Professor Herring began his legal career as an Honors Attorney with the U.S. Department of Transportation, where he spent four years litigating civil matters before federal courts and administrative tribunals. Thereafter, he practiced public international law for two years with the International Maritime Organization, a United Nations organization. In 1991, Professor Herring joined the U.S. […]
